title: RBAC i ServiceAccount: najmanje privilegije
summary: RBAC po principu najmanjih privilegija (opasni glagoli, pregled ko šta smije, smanjenje dozvola) i siguran rad sa ServiceAccountima i njihovim tokenima.
summary_en: Least-privilege RBAC (dangerous verbs, reviewing who can do what, reducing permissions) and safe use of ServiceAccounts and their tokens.
